label: other
name: Other Image Category Classification
description: Classify an unclear or unmatched non-OCR image into one or more fallback categories based on visual ambiguity, image quality, obstruction, corruption, or the absence of a recognizable primary subject.

labels.mixed_visual_content: An image containing several unrelated subjects with no single clear primary category.
labels.unknown_image: An image whose main subject cannot be confidently identified or matched to an available category.
labels.blurry_image: An image that is heavily blurred or out of focus, making the main subject difficult to recognize.
labels.low_quality_image: An image with very low resolution, poor lighting, heavy compression, or visual damage that prevents reliable classification.
labels.obstructed_image: An image where the main subject is largely hidden, cropped, covered, or blocked from view.
labels.empty_scene: An image showing an empty, plain, or visually insignificant scene without a clear searchable subject.
labels.corrupted_image: An image containing severe digital corruption, broken pixels, missing regions, or rendering errors.
